title: Add a connection: {provider}
envHint: Test mode is the provider's own sandbox: nothing you do there moves real money.
envTestBody: Use {brand}'s test mode. The money is not real, and NIVO books these credits as simulated.
envLiveBody: Real money. Pick this when the shop is ready to receive payments.
earlyAccessNote: This provider was set up from its public documents and has not been proven with a real account yet. Check the first transaction carefully.
fieldNameHint: A label only you see, for example Main account.
createdLocked: The connection is created. Changes here are saved when you press Next.
editSaved: Changes saved. Update the same values on {brand} too.
guideCopyHint: Copy it and paste it into this box on {brand}.
guideCopyEdit: You can change it here. Paste the same value into this box on {brand}.
keysHint: Paste every key above before you continue.
payosLocal: This site runs on your computer, so payOS cannot confirm the webhook address yet. That happens once the app runs on its public domain.
verifyError: Could not check right now. We will try again.
skipNote: The connection stays unfinished until the first transaction arrives. Continue it from the list.
zaloSkipNote: The connection stays unfinished until the first message arrives. Continue it from the list.
agentTitleChannel: Attach to the agents that use this channel
purpose_lead_source: Receives the leads of your lead ads
agentHint: Tick the agents that work through this connection. You can change this later in the agent Settings.
agentNone: There is no agent for this connection yet. Create one in Agents, then tick it in the agent Settings.
tgTokenHint: Keep the token private: anyone with it controls your bot.
zaloAppHint: From the app's general settings on Zalo Developers. Kept encrypted.
zaloOaSecretSaved: The OA Secret Key is saved.
zaloAuthorizeBody: NIVO opens Zalo so you can allow this app to read and answer your Official Account's messages. You come back here afterwards.
zaloAuthorized: Zalo OA is connected. NIVO keeps its access fresh by itself.
zaloAuthDenied: Zalo did not give access. Try again and press Allow on the Zalo screen.
zaloAuthFailed: Zalo did not accept the sign-in. Check the App ID and App secret, then connect again.
zaloAuthExpired: That sign-in took too long. Press Connect Zalo OA again.
zaloVerifyIntro: Send any message to your Official Account from a Zalo account that follows it.
zaloNeedSecret: Paste the OA Secret Key first: without it NIVO cannot tell real Zalo messages from fakes.
zaloAuthorizedOa: Zalo OA is connected (OA {id}). NIVO keeps its access fresh by itself.
